title: Head movement commutes with position transfer
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be an alphabet, $k$ a natural number, $a_0\in\Gamma$, and $x$ a word over the enlarged sweep alphabet. For every input-head position $p$ in the retracted word and every movement $d\in\{-1,0,1\}$, transferring the position to the longer word and then moving the head gives the same position as moving first and then transferring it.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a word over the enlarged sweep alphabet
$p$ is a valid input-head position for the retracted word
